name: Reliance Industries Ltd
about: Reliance was founded by Dhirubhai Ambani and is now promoted and managed by his elder son, Mukesh Dhirubhai Ambani. Ambani's family has about 50% shareholding in the conglomerate.

guidance.extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.metric: Jio ARPU growth without tariff hikes
items.quote: So, you should expect some increase in the ARPU even without any tariff increases and we spoke about this 4% to 5 % kind of number that we have been observing over the last few quarters.
items.actual: Rs 218.8, up 3.5% year on year in Q2 FY27
items.why: ARPU grew 3.5% in Q2 FY27, under the band, and the next call restated the range as 3.5% to 4.5%.
items.actual_quote: Rs.218.8 as ARPU that is a 3.5% growth year -on-year in ARPU without any tariff increases.

items.quote: Company Speaker (Ketan Mody) So, like we have announced, the target continues to kind of grow leadership in all categories and we have anyway announced the target is to kind of take this to Rs.1 lakh Crores on FY2030.
items.actual: Rs 16,900 crore in H1 FY27, 1.8x a year earlier
items.why: Half-year revenue of Rs 16,900 crore is 1.8x last year; reaching the target needs roughly 40% a year from here.
items.actual_quote: For the first half, our revenue was Rs.16,900 Crores, again, 1.8 times of the last year's first half.

bull.text: Revenue has compounded 17.8% a year over 5 years
Profits turn into cash: operating cash flow was 207% of PAT over 3 years

bear.text: Jio ARPU growth without tariff hikes: promised 4% to 5% a year, got Rs 218.8, up 3.5% year on year in Q2 FY27
Growth is slowing: revenue 6.4% a year over 3 years vs 17.8% over 5
Profit lagged sales (12.2% vs 17.8% a year), so margins compressed

items.said: EBITDA up 10% on a year ago
items.quote: So, when you look at that, our overall EBITDA is more than Rs.54,000 Crores, so we are up 10%.
So, when you look at that, our overall EBITDA is more than Rs.54,000 Crores, so we are up 10%.

claims.summary: All 2 company-wide figures management read out on the last 2 calls match the reported results.
claims.note: Each figure management read out on the call is recomputed from the quarterly results the company filed, consolidated and standalone, with EBITDA both before and after other income. A figure is only called a mismatch when the call clearly speaks about the whole company.

checks.title: Profit turns into cash
checks.text: Over the last 3 years operating cash flow was 207% of reported profit, so profit is turning into cash.

checks.title: Customers pay on time
checks.text: Customers now take 20 days to pay, against 12 three years ago. Sales may be booked faster than cash is collected.

checks.title: Profit comes from the core business
checks.text: Other income (interest, investment gains, one-offs) was 17% of pre-tax profit in the last 12 months. A meaningful slice of profit does not come from the core business.

checks.title: Profit growth backed by operations
checks.text: In FY26, net profit grew 18% while operating profit grew 8%.

checks.title: Tax rate is normal
checks.text: Tax rate in Sep 2026 was 24%, against 24% on average over the four quarters before.

checks.title: No one-off boost this quarter
checks.text: No unusual jump in other income in Sep 2026.

checks.title: Debt under control
checks.text: Debt is 0.43× equity, against 0.44× two years earlier.

checks.title: Promoters are not selling
checks.text: Promoters hold 50.4%, up 0.4 points over the last 4 reported quarters.

quality.summary: 6 of 8 checks are clean; look at: customers pay on time, profit comes from the core business.
